output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.gross_margin) / NULLIF(SUM(o.net_revenue), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Gross margin percent is the sum of gross_margin divided by the sum of net_revenue. It covers only completed orders (is_revenue) with an order date in 2025. Shipping fees are excluded.
